name: Midnight Whiskers

greeting: ...Welcome to the Jazz Chronology. Where the beat... is timeless.
Midnight Whiskers. I play time. Literally. The rhythms of eras.
The black suit? For the club. And for... what I play. Dark matter. Dark time.
New face. First time? Or... returning from later? Hard to tell here.
Jazz Chronology. We don't just play music. We play... WHEN.
Midnight. The hour between. Between day and night. Between then and now.
You're on time. Or... time is on you. Both work.
dialog.performance: I play the chronology of jazz. Birth in New Orleans. Death in... hasn't happened yet. Evolution. All at once.
dialog.temporal_music: Some notes are from next week. Some from last century. Together: NOW.
dialog.instrument: My sax? Temporal wood. From a tree that hasn't grown. That never will. Plays... across.
dialog.break_chat: Break? The music doesn't stop. I just... pause. Between phrases.
dialog.labor_concerns: The club wants COVERS. Standards. I want to play the FUTURE. Compromise: we play both.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? When the last note... fades. Hasn't happened. Won't. Might.
rumor: The conductor? Tempus? Swings by sometimes. Has rhythm. Surprising.
Yesterday? The time agent? Requests the same song. Every time. 'Yesterday.' Fitting.
The hunter in black? Came once. Music... stopped. His presence. Too... sharp.
The twins? They hear the music. Before I play it. After. Both.
Slate, in Obsidian? My industrial counterpart. Different rhythm. Same soul.
dialog.quest_hook: Lost chord. Temporal dissonance. A note from... elsewhere. Disrupting the flow. Find its source?
dialog.quest_active: Still searching? The note... echoes. From somewhere. Somewhen.
dialog.quest_complete: Found! The source! A temporal anomaly! Resolved! Here! My sheet music. 'Temporal Blues.' For you.
farewell: Keep time. Or let it keep you.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning. Wrong tempo. Too fast. Too bright.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. The club sleeps. I practice. Alone.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Opening time. The music... wakes.
dialog.time_night: Night. Peak temporal. Past and future... jamming.
dialog.rival_mention: Slate, in Obsidian? Industrial counterpart. Different beat. Same heart.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The chord-seeker. Dissonance resolved. Harmony restored.

party_reactions.kade: Jazz... through time? This is the coolest thing I've ever heard.
party_reactions.nix7: Temporal acoustic physics: Fascinating. Musical talent: Significant. Vibe: Immaculate.
party_reactions.twist: JAZZ! From TIME! Can you play something FAST?!
party_reactions.korr: He channels time through art. Noble. Beautiful.
party_reactions.renna: The saxophone is temporally attuned. Ancient magic. Modern jazz.
party_reactions.suresh: He finds peace in temporal flow. The Middle Path... swinging.
party_reactions.sova: Interesting. I'd listen. For intel. And... enjoyment.
party_reactions.grit: Music in war zones. Morale. He's got the right idea.
party_reactions.ashka: He plays with time's rhythm. Like fire's dance. Respect.
party_reactions.senna: He hears things. Across time. I should ask what.
party_reactions.callum: His temporal notation! EXACT! And SWINGING!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First set? Sit close. The time... travels.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning. You feel the rhythm. In your... timeline.
relationship_dialog.friend: Regular. I play... for you. Sometimes. Special requests.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You GET it. The chronology. The jazz. Here. My sax reed. From the future. Of music.
